name: Oumi
source:
"Turning 20 degrees to port side. Direction is clear, all green. Departure preparations all finished."

The one in charge of steering the VOX.
The honor student type who can't take jokes. He doesn't realize it himself and is often made fun of.
He says he has a strange sense of taste, but he has quite the sweet tooth.
